description: Audit a property against municipal building, renovation, and demolition permit records (Chattanooga, Nashville, Memphis, Knoxville) to identify premature lien-date additions, demolished structures still assessed on CAMA rolls, and routine maintenance protections under T.C.A. § 67-5-601/603 (Exhibit P).

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default) or 'html' for ready-to-file Exhibit P

jurisdiction.description: County or municipal jurisdiction name (e.g. Hamilton, Davidson, Shelby, Knox)
